name: mcp-brew
stderr:
Usage: mcp [options] [command]

Homebrew for MCP — install, configure, and manage Model Context Protocol
servers.

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  install [options] <name>     Install and configure an MCP server for detected
                               clients
  uninstall <name>             Remove an MCP server's config and forget it
  up [options] <name>          Enable an installed MCP server
  down [options] <name>        Disable an installed MCP server without
                               forgetting its config
  status                       Show installed MCP servers and whether they're
                               active
  upgrade [options] [name]     Check the upstream registry for a newer version
                               and reinstall if found
  pin <name>                   Exclude an installed server from "mcp upgrade
                               --all"
  unpin <name>                 Allow an installed server to be upgraded by "mcp
                               upgrade --all" again
  doctor                       Check runtimes, client configs, secrets backend,
                               and locks for problems
  rollback [options] <client>  Restore a client's MCP config from the most
                               recent mcp-cli backup
  list                         List all MCP servers in the registry
  search <query>               Search the MCP registry by name or description
  secrets                      Manage secret values used by MCP servers
  registry                     Manage additional MCP server registries beyond
                               the bundled ones
  help [command]               display help for command
